_meta.purpose: Seed data for future mapping into the app's Application object (lib/types.ts). Not wired into lib/mock/data.ts or any app code. Research-only, per issue #4.

applications.name: Robotic Pick-and-Place / Material Handling
applications.description: Robot arms performing pick-and-place, palletizing, or material-handling tasks, requiring application-specific gripper jaws and EOAT.

evidence.summary: EOAT engineered for palletizing, pick and place, grinding, and assembly applications.

applications.name: Machine Vision / Inspection
applications.description: Camera- or sensor-based inspection and vision-guided robotics, requiring vibration-isolated, precisely aligned sensor/camera mounts.

evidence.summary: Robotic vision camera bracket designed to eliminate micro-movements that disrupt focal stability during high-speed operation.

applications.name: Collaborative Robot (Cobot) Integration
applications.description: Integrating a collaborative robot into a production cell, requiring mounting adapters, safety enclosures, and often a coupled inspection/assembly fixture build.

evidence.summary: Design and implementation of cobot inspection and assembly cells with tailored custom tooling.

applications.name: Mobile Robot / AMR Chassis & Sensor Integration
applications.description: Autonomous mobile robots and similar platforms requiring LiDAR/sensor mounts, motor mounts, and structural chassis components.

evidence.summary: LiDAR mounts and encoder/camera brackets named as a standing product line for robotics customers.

applications.name: Humanoid Robotics Actuation & Joints
applications.description: Humanoid robot developers sourcing precision joint/actuator housings under 2026 supply-chain pressure on high-precision actuator and gearbox components.

evidence.summary: Humanoid robot boom straining precision-component supply chain (screws, bearings, high-performance actuators); Schaeffler announced new strain-wave-gearbox manufacturing process Aug 2026.
Dedicated technical content on machining harmonic-drive housings specifically for humanoid joints.

applications.name: Assembly / QC Fixturing
applications.description: Fixtures, jigs, and check tooling supporting manual or robot-assisted assembly and quality-control inspection stations.

evidence.summary: Check fixtures, welding fixtures, turnkey fixtures, and jig services offered with free quotes.
